key_reasoning.reason: New file:/// URI decoding and validation (encoded slash/dot/NUL, backslash, query, non-canonical segments) in export.py is a new injection surface; the existing _check_path covers explicit paths but not URI decoding, so it diverges. Shared in-flight byte budget, per-call/per-file/file-count limits and the never-lose-tool-result fallback add resource and data-loss sensitivity. Edge-case tables are exercised in test_export_collect/test_export_links.

9 files per diffstat: one source module (export.py), three new test/fixture files (test_export_links.py, test_export_links_e2e.py, link_server.py), two modified tests, plus README, architecture guide and spec docs.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk raised to L: URI-to-path decoding is a security-sensitive surface the existing _check_path does not cover
Technical Risk: acceptance edge/error cases enumerated (refusal reasons, limits, dedup) with parameterized-style tests added in the same change
